REQ-01: Validate illustrative flow/stretch setpoints, including boundaries, types and non-finite values; reject configuration while running.
REQ-02: Start only after configuration and fresh safe telemetry; stop disables outputs.
REQ-03: Reject stale, future, duplicate or reordered sensor packets; accepted sequence and timestamp must increase monotonically.
REQ-04: Missing telemetry beyond two seconds latches a fault and disables simulated outputs.
REQ-05: Pressure above 120 illustrative kPa latches a fault; unsafe pressure prevents start/reset.
REQ-06: Three consecutive flow deviations beyond max(1,10% of setpoint) latch a fault; an in-tolerance sample resets the streak.
REQ-07: Faults remain latched after stop or healthy telemetry; explicit reset requires fresh safe telemetry and discards old configuration.
REQ-08: Persist successful commands and audit records transactionally; identical command IDs replay without side effects and conflicting reuse is rejected.
REQ-09: Restart never resumes running outputs; prior RUNNING or FAULT state becomes a review-required fault.
REQ-10: Local TCP transport handles fragmented frames, malformed JSON, oversize frames, timeouts and reconnects without changing controller state on invalid messages.
REQ-11: Concurrent command retries yield one applied command and one durable audit entry.
REQ-12: The stale-start regression test must fail when freshness validation is deliberately replaced with a defective test double.
